title: 🚀 Artonaut #9
text:
🚀 “Artonaut #9” — when street art goes interstellar.
The ninth chapter in Mark Rox’s iconic Artonaut series — painted in acrylics, charged with UV-reactive pigments, and ready to glow under blacklight, revealing hidden codes and symbols. 🔥

🐎 This is the only piece in the series featuring an animal — a full-power graffiti horse carrying an Artonaut in a riot of colors, tags, and futuristic vibes.
Second-largest in the series, this work fuses the eternal image of the rider with the pulse of street culture and a sci-fi edge.

✨ Activate it through AR, and watch the scene break out of the frame.
Not just art. A journey.

title: 🪐 Mark Rox – Artonaut #10
text:
025, canvas, acrylics, neon pigments, texture paste

Artonaut #10 is the tenth piece in Mark Rox’s iconic Artonauts series and the first part of a diptych, continued in Artonaut #11.
The painting features a female artonaut stepping forward with bold energy and purpose. Her suit is a vibrant fusion of street art, graffiti, symbols, and color — a celebration of freedom, movement, and the strength of creative identity.

The reflection in her helmet visor adds emotional depth, as if we’re catching a glimpse of her world through her own eyes — a moment of quiet power.

Just like the rest of the series, this piece glows under UV light, revealing hidden layers and messages that remain invisible under regular lighting. It speaks to the complexity of identity — what’s visible versus what’s hidden within.

With the AR app, the painting comes to life — adding a dynamic digital layer that expands the viewer’s experience into the realm of augmented reality.

130x97cm
descr: 🪐 Mark Rox – Artonaut #10 025, canvas, acrylics, neon pigments, texture paste

title: 🪐 Mark Rox – Artonaut #11
text:
2025, canvas, acrylics, neon pigments, texture paste

Artonaut #11 is the eleventh piece in Mark Rox’s iconic Artonauts series.
This time, the spotlight is on a female figure — bold, empowered, and intuitive. Her vibrant astronaut suit becomes a symbol of inner freedom, creative chaos, and fearless self-expression.

Every element of the suit blends street art, neon color schemes, and hidden symbols. The palette is intentionally loud; the posture dynamic and unapologetic — as if to say: “I’m here. I move. I am art.”

Like the rest of the series, this painting glows under UV light, revealing hidden messages and visual elements that remain invisible in normal lighting.

Through the AR app, the artwork comes to life — adding a digital layer that opens up an interactive, augmented reality experience.

title: 🚀 Artonaut #13
text:
“Artonaut #13” — the thirteenth chapter in Mark Rox’s Artonaut series. Created in acrylics with UV-reactive pigments, it glows under blacklight and, like every work in the series, comes alive through an AR experience.

This time, the artist strips the palette down to pure essentials: black, white, and red. The limited colors intensify the contrasts, making the Artonaut appear as if he’s leaping out of a graphic novel or a street mural set loose in space. Despite the restriction, the energy is multiplied — every line and every splash of red vibrates with movement.

By merging raw graffiti codes, futuristic symbolism, and the timeless figure of the space traveler, Artonaut #13 becomes both a visual explosion and a distilled essence of the series.

title: 🚀 Artonaut #14
text:
Artonaut #14” — the fourteenth chapter in Mark Rox’s iconic Artonaut series. Painted in acrylics with UV-reactive pigments, it glows under blacklight and, like every piece in the series, comes alive through an AR experience.

Here, the Artonaut’s suit explodes into a riot of neon graffiti — a full spectrum of colors, tags, and symbols layered across every surface. The once-functional armor becomes a moving street canvas, merging cosmic exploration with urban expression. It’s not just a traveler of outer space, but also a carrier of street culture into the infinite.

By fusing graffiti energy with futuristic vision, Artonaut #14 turns into a vibrant manifesto of freedom, color, and artistic rebellion.

title: Kaleidoscope
text:
Mark Rox 
Oil on canvas 
Created in the aftermath of a personal rupture, Kaleidoscope explores the fragmentation of the inner world. The composition unfolds through intersecting forms that echo the logic of a kaleidoscope — where broken elements reorganize into new visual rhythms. 
Contrasts of warm and cool tones reflect the tension between emotional intensity and detachment. Rather than remaining in collapse, the work suggests movement toward reconfiguration and balance. 
A meditation on rupture, perception, and transformation.
descr: Mark Rox  Oil on canvas  Created in the aftermath of a personal rupture, Kaleidoscope explores the fragmentation of the inner world.

title: Mermaid
text:
Oil on canvas. Mark Rox, Castelldefels, Catalunya, 2024. 

In this work, Mark Rox turns to the image of the mermaid as a symbol of the inner world — a threshold between reality and myth, serenity and unrest. The figure of the mythological woman, captured in a moment of sleep or meditation, becomes a metaphor for the artist’s emotional state during his time living on the Catalan coast. 

While residing in Castelldefels, Rox was in daily dialogue with the vastness of the sea — an experience reflected in the palette. Dominated by aquamarine, emerald, and muted ochre tones, the composition conveys a sense of depth and tranquility.
descr: Oil on canvas. Mark Rox, Castelldefels, Catalunya, 2024.

title: Untitled (Portal Fragment)
text:
Mark Rox, 2024 
Spray paint, acrylic, graffiti technique on custom engineered material 
Approx. 200 × 200 cm 
This large-scale street art piece by Mark Rox explores the illusion of depth through a meticulously constructed visual “portal” carved into a fractured architectural surface. Executed in a refined spray paint and acrylic graffiti technique, the work merges sharp geometric structure with fluid chromatic transitions, creating a hypnotic passage that appears to extend infinitely beyond the wall. 
Produced on a specially engineered material, this piece exists as a high-end street art sticker — a format that bridges the raw language of urban art with the flexibility of contemporary installation. It can be mounted directly onto walls using a dedicated adhesive system, allowing for both temporary and permanent placement without compromising visual integrity. 
Balancing precision and spontaneity, Mark Rox transforms a flat surface into a dimensional experience, inviting the viewer to step into a constructed reality where graffiti evolves beyond surface intervention into spatial illusion.
descr: Mark Rox, 2024  Spray paint, acrylic, graffiti technique on custom engineered

title: Piece of Art
text:
a bold and liberating departure in Mark Rox’s artistic journey, where emotion, movement, and pure visual energy take center stage. 

Executed in oil on canvas and measuring 250 × 150 cm, Piece of Art marks a conscious shift away from narrative density and symbolic decoding. In this work, Rox steps away from layered meanings to focus on the immediacy of perception, inviting the viewer into a visceral, sensory experience driven entirely by color, flow, and rhythm. 

🌊 The composition evokes the illusion of ink dissolving in water. The surface remains in constant motion — pigments breathe, merge, and transform across the canvas without a fixed center or hierarchy. 

📱 Extending beyond the physical canvas, Piece of Art can be activated through an augmented reality application, revealing additional layers of flowing color, movement, and energetic interaction — transforming the painting into a living, immersive experience.
descr: a bold and liberating departure in Mark Rox’s artistic journey, where emotion, movement, and pure visual energy take center stage.

title: Magic Orange Forest
text:
a portal into one of Mark Rox’s unseen universes, where fantasy and inner exploration merge into a single flowing landscape. 
Created in a mixed technique of oil painting with the addition of UV-reactive acrylics, the artwork transforms under ultraviolet light, revealing hidden layers and glowing elements that awaken like a parallel reality 🌌🔊. What seems calm and dreamlike in daylight becomes alive, pulsating with energy and mystery. 
A surreal path of stairs leads the viewer deep into an otherworldly forest, where organic forms twist into architecture, and nature fuses with imagination. The dominant orange tones symbolize warmth, transformation, and a kind of inner fire — a guiding force for those who dare to move forward 🔥🚀. 
This is not just a landscape, but a journey — a space where Artonauts, or the artist himself, wander through unknown dimensions, searching, creating, and discovering new meanings beyond the visible 🌠🧠. 
The work reflects Mark Rox’s signature vision: blending street-art energy, fine art technique, and immersive experience into a living, evolving piece that exists both in physical and augmented realms.

descr: a portal into one of Mark Rox’s unseen universes, where fantasy and inner exploration merge into a single flowing landscape.

title: Avengers — Private Edition
text:
by Mark Rox is a powerful large-scale work (2 meters wide), where the artist brings together five of his favorite Marvel superheroes into one unified, explosive composition. 
Painted using a refined combination of oil painting and airbrush techniques, the piece balances classical depth with hyper-realistic precision. Each character — from the raw force of Hulk to the technological brilliance of Iron Man — is rendered with cinematic intensity, as if frozen mid-action in a moment of collective impact. 
The artwork extends beyond the canvas: through augmented reality, it comes alive, transforming a static scene into an immersive experience where motion, energy, and atmosphere continue beyond the painted surface. 📲✨ 
Created exclusively for his private collection, this piece lives inside the artist’s studio in Barcelona — a daily reminder of inspiration, ambition, and childhood mythology reborn through contemporary art. 
Not exhibited publicly, it remains a rare and almost hidden work, available only to true collectors and devoted Marvel Avengers fans. 🔊

title: Gravity Doesn’t Exist
text:
A powerful standalone work by Mark Rox, created in 2025 for the MOSS Foundation Skaters — a volunteer-driven initiative that builds permanent clean water systems for communities in Africa. 
Executed in oil and UV-reactive acrylics across six skateboard decks, the piece transforms recycled skate surfaces into a unified visual narrative — merging fine art, street culture, and social impact into a single object. 
At the center, a drifting astronaut collides with the language of skateboarding — not floating in space, but suspended between motion and meaning. The skateboard becomes a global symbol: youth, freedom, rebellion — and now, responsibility. 
This work exists beyond the Artonaut series, stepping into reality — where art is no longer just expression, but action. 
The project is part of the MOSS Skate Art Exhibition, where over 90 artists reimagined skateboard decks as artworks, all contributing to a collective mission: raising funds for clean water infrastructure in Africa. 
The tension within the piece is subtle but powerful: 
while the figure floats in weightlessness, millions remain bound by the absence of something as fundamental as clean water. 
✨ Exhibited at Palo Alto Barcelona as part of the MOSS exhibition 
💧 Proceeds from the sale of this artwork contribute to building water wells in Africa 
📲 Learn more: mossfoundationskaters

title: Artonaut #19
text:
the nineteenth chapter in Mark Rox’s cult Artonaut series and the largest work by surface area to date. Created in 2026 with acrylics, UV-reactive and phosphorescent pigments, it glows under blacklight, radiates in complete darkness ✨, and comes alive through an augmented reality experience 📲. 
This time the Artonaut is no longer just an explorer — he is a statement. A massive black figure, grounded and unapologetically present, sitting in a relaxed pose that feels both powerful and detached. Covered in chaotic layers of graffiti, symbols, and personal marks, the suit becomes a direct extension of the artist himself 🎨. 
This piece is about self-expression pushed to its extreme — where identity becomes louder than the world around it 🔊. It reflects the raw, unfiltered feeling of ego: not hidden, not softened, but amplified. The Artonaut doesn’t try to fit in — he occupies space, dominates it, and redefines it 🌌. 
The contrast between the deep black form and the explosive neon energy intensifies this idea: silence versus noise, control versus chaos, ego versus everything else. 
Yet beneath this bold presence lies the ongoing mission of the series — a call for peace ☮️, nuclear disarmament, and the triumph of art over war. Because even ego, at its highest intensity, still seeks meaning beyond itself. 
#Artonaut #MarkRox #UrbanArt #StreetArt #GraffitiArt #UVart #ARart #Ego #SelfExpression #ContemporaryArt
descr: the nineteenth chapter in Mark Rox’s cult Artonaut series and the largest work by surface area to date.

title: 🌍 Artonaut #12
text:
🌍 “Artonaut #12” — the twelfth work in Mark Rox’s Artonaut series, created in acrylic with UV-reactive pigments that come to life under blacklight, revealing hidden details and enhancing the visible ones. Like all pieces in the series, it can be brought to life through AR.

In reality, an astronaut is a tiny figure adrift in the vastness of space, with Earth appearing as a massive and dominant presence. In this piece, however, Mark Rox inverts that perspective: the planet becomes small and fragile, while the Artonaut is rendered monumental, almost sculptural. He sits as if resting after a long journey, watching the miniature Earth float in the void.

This shift in scale creates the sensation of peering into a world where the familiar laws of space and the roles we assign are reversed — a place where the artist plays with our perception of reality itself.
